Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our engineering and clinical teams are aligned enough that we want to get an official MAP (mutual action plan) and a short evaluation timeline in place so we can present to procurement and the CTO.

Specific asks from us:
- A simple MAP template we can edit (week0/week1 milestones + owners)
- Suggested tech validation checklist for a 2-week pilot (data connectors, latency targets, sample throughput)
- A recommended close timeline (key decision dates for procurement and security review)

We're hoping to have a short internal review by next Friday (7/30). Can your team share a starter doc and a suggested 30/60/90 cadence so we can slot it into our procurement window?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30 min call if that's easier.

Best,

Liam — thanks for the clear asks and the requirements PDF. I've dropped a starter MAP and a week-0 play slate into a Google doc + slides; links below.

High level proposal (starter):
- Week 0 (Kickoff & access): Verify VPN/VPC access, sample dataset ingest (sanitized), assign technical owners
- Week 1 (Integration & smoke tests): Data connector validation, model selection + baseline prompts, 1k sample chat/requests run
- Week 2 (Pilot validation & metrics): Latency and throughput measurement, edge-case evals, quality check against your acceptance prompts

Decision timeline suggestion:
- 07/27 — Internal technical checkpoint (our live walk-through)
- 07/30 — Procurement initial review (your side)
- 08/06 — Pilot results and go/no-go recommendation
- 08/13 — Procurement/contract sign-off target

Starter assets: 
- MAP draft (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_example_map_draft
- Week0 MAP slides (owner/RACI): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1xYz_example_week0
- Live checklist: see slide 3 for access steps and required entitlements

I've attached a condensed Week0 outline as slides for easy sharing (week0-MAP-outline.gslides). Also attaching a copy of the MAP in Word/printable form.

Next steps for us:
1) You and Helena review the draft and highlight any missing milestones or compliance asks in the doc by 07/23.
2) We'll run a 30-minute kickoff workshop (I propose 07/27 11:00am PT) to walk owners and run through access tasks.

If that sounds good I'll lock the invite and include technical leads (Jasmine for infra, Marissa for onboarding cadence).

—Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0122

Attachments: week0-MAP-outline.gslides (slide deck), MAP-printable.docx
